init_shapenetcore_dataset: initialize a ShapeNetCore dataset from a data directory with optional synset categories and version
getitem_load_mesh: load a 3D mesh model by index returning vertices, faces, textures, and synset label
render_shapenetcore_models: render ShapeNetCore 3D models using a Phong shader with configurable camera and lighting
sample_idxs_from_category: sample random model indices from a specific ShapeNetCore synset category for training
review_shapenetcore_synset_mapping: review the ShapeNetCore synset offset to label dictionary mapping for version 1 or 2
